profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker SOUN and headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, with CIK 0001840856 on file. Its website describes it as a provider of conversational AI agents for the real world, built on its OASYS platform. According to the company, that platform powers voice-native AI agents that handle service, operations, and commerce conversations for enterprise brands.

The site presents the technology through customer accounts rather than product listings. One customer says SoundHound's agentic AI lets it resolve more requests faster and scale operations as demand grows. Another describes using the voice AI to help franchisees process orders more efficiently, particularly at peak hours, for a faster and more consistent ordering experience. A third cites hybrid cloud and embedded connectivity as the basis for always-on voice experiences for customers on the go. The company's own framing is that these agents are voice-native and aimed at enterprise deployments.

Beyond the corporate profile, the record shows no individual lawsuits named against the company, though it carries 33 Delaware-linked litigation matters. No products or MCP servers are tracked for it.
